modern: Alexander the Macedonian and his groom were brought by death to the same state; for either they were taken back into the same seed-principles of the universe, or they were alike scattered among the atoms.
original: Alexander the Macedonian and his groom by death were brought to the same state; for either they were received among the same seminal principles of the universe, or they were alike dispersed among the atoms.
